# Standby Pro

> Independent open-source Flutter bedside clock by Ghostzy0. Original repository and history preserved. Version 1.1.0 preview adds layouts, local visual focus timer, clear sample/unavailable integrations, optional city weather and defensive local preferences. No production native binary, system StandBy integration or physical phone acceptance is claimed.

- [Setup and platform limits](https://ghostzy0.github.io/standby-pro/guide.html)
- [Privacy and data](https://ghostzy0.github.io/standby-pro/privacy.html)
- [Source and current context](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/standby-pro)
- [Versioned releases](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/standby-pro/releases)
- [Historical baseline provenance](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/standby-pro-baseline)
- [Device acceptance gaps](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/standby-pro/issues/4)

AI setup: Clone Ghostzy0/standby-pro at the desired release tag. Read CONTEXT.md and release notes. Use Flutter 3.41.9/Dart3.11.5, run locked dependencies, analysis and tests. Do not substitute browser/widget evidence for Android/iPhone physical acceptance.
